source_description: Dark-green wine bottle, tan cork, narrow neck and larger body. Current position and upright/tipped posture must be read from current RGB.
receiver_description: Inclined wooden slatted bottle rack behind and left of the bottle, beside the dark cabinet.
relevant_visual_cues: The bottle has a rounded dark body, slender neck, and contrasting tan cork.
The wrist image shows the bottle beside the bowl and wooden rack.
The rack has pale wooden slats and darker wooden end supports.
Exact support contacts and clearances are unknown from these views.

stages.name: Align above bottle
stages.goal: Position the open hand above a graspable bottle section.
stages.exit: The actor-selected source surface is coarsely aligned with the finger gap in world X/Y (each reference difference within 10mm), and current RGB supports a suitable approach orientation. This is not contact proof.
perception_inputs: Current bottle mask and visible orientation
Finger gap in fixed and wrist RGB
Nearby rack, bowl and cabinet boundaries

control_contract.translation: Align horizontally for the selected grasp relationship. The selected source dot is a surface reference, not a grasp centre.
control_contract.height: Maintain suitable overhead clearance. Already being safely above is not a reason to rise further.
control_contract.exit: Horizontal alignment and approach orientation are suitable; continue to descent.

stages.name: Descend around bottle
stages.goal: Bring the fingers alongside the selected section.
stages.exit: The hand appears positioned for a closure attempt. Proven contact is not required.

control_contract.translation: Approach the visually selected grasp region. Preserve horizontal alignment and account for finger geometry.
control_contract.exit: The hand appears positioned for a closure attempt. Proven contact is not required.

stages.name: Close
stages.goal: Close the fingers around the bottle.
stages.exit: Closure was attempted. Continue if engagement looks plausible; retry alignment if clearly missed.

control_contract.translation: Hold position unless a visible positioning problem requires returning to alignment.
control_contract.gripper: Attempt closure; then inspect the result.
control_contract.exit: Closure was attempted. Continue if engagement looks plausible; retry alignment if clearly missed.

stages.name: Lift
stages.goal: Briefly test whether your selected visible bottle feature rises with the closed hand before beginning combined reorientation and approach.
stages.exit: The camera-derived selected feature rises at least20mm and its motion agrees with measured own translation within10mm per axis, with a valid same-origin RGB match. This is a provisional motion test, not a contact or holding certificate.

control_contract.translation: Briefly test visible bottle following and table separation; rack-approach clearance is a later task.
control_contract.exit: The camera-derived selected feature rises at least20mm and its motion agrees with measured own translation within10mm per axis, with a valid same-origin RGB match. This is a provisional motion test, not a contact or holding certificate.
control_contract.failure: If the source does not follow, reassess the grasp.

stages.name: Reorient and approach rack
stages.goal: Bring the held bottle into the intended lengthwise receiving relationship while approaching the rack.
stages.exit: The visible bottle has the intended relationship to the selected receiving bay, with an apparently clear approach in the fixed views.
perception_inputs: Current rack supports and channel direction

control_contract.references: Select separate held-source and receiver surface dots and a suitable placement relationship from RGB.
control_contract.translation: Align the held SOURCE relative to the RECEIVER horizontally. Do not substitute gripper-to-receiver alignment.
control_contract.height: Maintain clearance for the held object, not merely the gripper.
control_contract.exit: The visible bottle has the intended relationship to the selected receiving bay, with an apparently clear approach in the fixed views.

stages.name: Align and seat on rack
stages.goal: Bring the held bottle into the intended visible support arrangement.
stages.exit: The bottle visibly occupies the intended support arrangement across available views, with sufficiently clear seating evidence to consider release. Apparent overlap alone is insufficient.

control_contract.translation: Bring the held source toward a visually suitable supported relationship with the receiver while preserving lateral alignment.
control_contract.exit: The bottle visibly occupies the intended support arrangement across available views, with sufficiently clear seating evidence to consider release. Apparent overlap alone is insufficient.

stages.name: Release
stages.goal: Open the fingers without disturbing the bottle.
stages.exit: Opening is observed or reported; continue to inspection.

control_contract.translation: Hold position during opening unless visible safety constraints require replanning.
control_contract.exit: Opening is observed or reported; continue to inspection.

stages.name: Clear and inspect
stages.goal: Separate the hand from the resting bottle.
stages.exit: The fingers are visibly separated from the bottle, the hand is clear, and the bottle remains in the intended arrangement across successive observations.
perception_inputs: Current hand, bottle and rack RGB

control_contract.exit: The fingers are visibly separated from the bottle, the hand is clear, and the bottle remains in the intended arrangement across successive observations.

coarse_alignment_scope: Outer experimental adaptation: explicit XY feature-positioning semantics; source reference and orientation remain actor choices. A 10mm stopping band is a control heuristic, not measured sensor accuracy. Z and rotations have no algorithmic target error.
